base.basis: Margins stabilise near the TTM 29.6% [IS-T] with ROIC 18.5% [RA] and EV/EBITDA recovers modestly from 6.8x, a 3% position in its 5y range [RA]; set below the mechanical base of 38.59 because that FCFE value extrapolates float-assisted FCF (note section 3).

bear.basis: Italy/Brazil regulation spreads and the operating margin keeps falling from its 34.3% 2-year high [IS-T] while leverage rises toward 2x from 1.65x [RA]: the mechanical bear fair value of 21.15 [fact sheet Fair value].

bull.basis: Guided 2027-2028 growth resumes after the rebasing year (Q3 2026 transcript) and P/E re-rates partway from 11.9x toward its 5y median 32.3x [RA]; set below the mechanical bull of 55.24 because FCF margin of 38.2% is float-flattered versus 23.6% a year earlier [CF-T].

request.thesis: A benefits and mobility payments network with stable-high returns (ROIC 18.5%) is going through a guided, regulation-driven margin reset, yet trades near the bottom of its own 5-year P/E and EV/EBITDA ranges, where the price implies a revenue decline that reaffirmed guidance and 6.6% Q3 intrinsic growth do not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 26%, extending the guided reset (29.6% now, 34.3% a year earlier) into structural take-rate compression from regulation.
TTM ROIC falls below 14%, giving up most of the recovery from 10.0% in FY2023 and signalling the network moat is eroding.
Management cuts or withdraws the FY2026 EBITDA guidance or the 2027-2028 growth target in a results release, or a further country imposes a meal-voucher fee cap.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 2.5x (1.65x TTM now), or ROCE on the ratios page falls below 22%.

CI.thesis: A deleveraging managed-care and PBM franchise with ROIC rising to 13.4% and a 12.29% FCF yield trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a -16% revenue decline that reaffirmed guidance does not support.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 9%, giving up the five-year improvement from 8.8% to 13.4%.
TTM operating margin falls below 3.5%, under the FY2025 five-year low of 3.7%, showing PBM reform or medical-cost pressure is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM net margin falls below 1.5%, near the FY2024 trough of 1.4%, confirming margin compression is structural.
TTM FCF margin falls below 2.5%, under the five-year low of 3.1%, signalling earnings quality and buyback capacity are deteriorating.

DECK.thesis: A net-cash, 70%+-ROIC footwear brand owner trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 9.09% FCF yield with 6.97% annual share shrinkage, pricing a revenue decline that beat-and-guide-growth results do not show.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the FY2024 level of 55.6%, showing rival discounting is eroding full-price discipline.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 18.0%.
TTM ROIC falls below 60%, under the FY2022 five-year low of 60.8%, showing brand-moat economics are deteriorating.
FY2027 annual revenue (income statement page) declines year on year, showing HOKA and UGG together are shrinking rather than slowing.

GDDY.thesis: A deleveraging, high-ROIC domain and SMB-software franchise with a 33.7% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a revenue decline that growing bookings and raised guidance do not show.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year improvement from 12.5% (FY2021) to 28.7%.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, erasing the post-2023 step-up (FY2024 20.4%).
TTM FCF margin falls below 25%, under the FY2024 level of 27.6%, showing the cash gains were transitory.
Total bookings growth in the 10-Q/earnings release falls below 4% y/y for two consecutive quarters (AI substitution showing in demand), or net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x.

HKG:2076.thesis: China's leading direct-chat recruitment platform, with net cash, a 50.9% FCF margin and accelerating 14.1% revenue growth, trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple at a 9.28% FCF yield, pricing a China/VIE discount that its fundamentals do not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 16.0%, showing the AI-matching and network-effect cost advantage has eroded.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2023 five-year low of 82.2%, signalling pricing or competitive pressure on employer paid services.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2023 level of 35.1%, showing the cash-generation step-up was transitory.
Reported quarterly revenue (company release / income statement) declines YoY for two consecutive quarters, ending the growth acceleration seen in Q2 2026 (+14.1%).

HKG:3998.thesis: China's leading down-jacket brand, with 81.2% ROIC, net cash and a 12.15% FCF yield, trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales, where the price implies a -13.0% revenue decline its margins and cash flow do not show.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the five-year low of 57.2%, signalling loss of brand pricing power.
TTM net margin falls below 10%, reversing the five-year rise to 14.6% and indicating the brand premium has eroded.
TTM ROIC falls below 40%, a reversion toward FY2022 levels that undercuts the moat thesis.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 five-year low of 12.2%, signalling inventory or working-capital stress from a demand down-cycle.

HKG:9999.thesis: A net-cash games franchise with operating margin up to 35.2% and a 43.5% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and near its P/FCF low, where the price implies a revenue decline its improving fundamentals do not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 28.1%, reversing the five-year expansion.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 36.5%, signalling cash generation is no longer keeping pace.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2024 level of 62.5%, indicating game-portfolio mix or monetization is deteriorating.
A new PRC regulation materially restricts game monetization, or a VIE-related regulatory action forces deconsolidation, as disclosed in a company filing or release.

HRB.thesis: A 23%-operating-margin, high-ROIC assisted tax-prep leader trades in the bottom fifth of its own 5-year multiples at a 13.92% FCF yield, where the price implies a -15.4% revenue decline that guided growth and 6% annual share shrinkage do not support.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 43%, breaking the five-year low (44.3% TTM, 44.3%-45.7% FY range), signalling price pressure from free/AI filing alternatives.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, under the five-year low of 21.5% (FY2022), showing the margin expansion has reversed.
TTM FCF margin falls below 15%, under the FY2025 five-year low of 15.9%, meaning cash generation no longer funds the buyback and dividend.
Annual revenue (income statement) declines year on year for a full fiscal year, or management discloses a loss of assisted-category share, evidencing real displacement by free or DIY filing.

INTU.thesis: A net-cash, 40%-FCF-margin franchise with five years of rising ROIC and operating margin trades at the floor of its own 5-year multiples and a 9.82% FCF yield, pricing a guided fiscal 2027 reset as permanent.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 15%, back to the FY2022 level, showing the returns expansion has reversed.
TTM operating margin falls below 23%, under the FY2024 level of 23.7%, showing restructuring and AI spend are not turning into efficiency.
TTM FCF margin falls below 29%, back to the FY2024 level, meaning the FY2026 cash step-up was transitory.
TTM gross margin falls below 78%, under the FY2023 five-year low of 79.3%, signalling free/AI tax-filing competition is forcing price cuts.

JKHY.thesis: A high-return, unlevered core-banking franchise whose returns and margins have improved since entry still trades below its own 5-year median multiples, but the price now implies growth above what has been delivered, so the remaining upside is modest.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 19%, the FY2024 trough, evidencing moat erosion.
TTM operating margin falls below 22%, under the FY2024 low of 22.1%, showing cloud/AI/security investment or renewal pricing is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM FCF margin falls below 20%, reversing the 5-year rising trend (FY2026 27.3%).
Processing revenue growth in the 10-Q MD&A falls below 5% year on year for two consecutive quarters.

LDOS.thesis: A government-IT incumbent with ROIC up from 9.9% to 14.2% and a 13.80% FCF yield funding buybacks trades below its own 5-year minimum on every earnings multiple and below peers, where the price implies a -13.7% revenue decline that its contract base does not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 10%, reversing the five-year expansion from 8.5% to 11.8%.
TTM ROIC falls below 10%, erasing the improvement from 9.9% in FY2021 to 14.2%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 6%, under the FY2022 five-year low of 6.0%, showing the cash step-up was transitory.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x (2.45x TTM now) without a visible deleveraging path from the Entrust/Analogic debt.

OTIS.thesis: A service-led elevator franchise with ROIC rising to 58.0% still trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple and below peers, pricing a transitory margin squeeze and CEO transition as permanent impairment.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2021 5-year low of 15.2%, showing the service-margin squeeze is structural.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 5-year low of 10.0%, showing cash generation is deteriorating with margins.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.5x (3.12x TTM now), showing capital returns are outrunning cash generation.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below the FY2022 5-year low of 69.7%, signalling structural loss of pricing power rather than cyclical volume softness.
TTM operating margin falls below the FY2023 5-year low of 35.9%, showing competition is eroding profitability, not just growth.
US companion-animal in-clinic share (dermatology), as reported on the earnings call, declines again in a second consecutive quarter beyond the -10pp YoY already seen.
Management cuts FY2026 adjusted net income guidance below the low end of the current 9%-5% decline range on the Q3 2026 call or later.
